description: B3 -> B4 / P5 boundary for Week 3. B3 receives BuyerCriteria (already refined by B2) carrying several strict filters - budget min/max, category, creator, period, location. The orchestrator carries the whole criteria object unchanged onto the B4 results handoff and the P5 unmatched-demand handoff, and never loosens the budget. B3 does not narrow to a subset of fields, and does not filter, group, or merge criteria in Week 3. hardConstraints stays [] - B2 (or the Week 4 connect step) fills it. Contains no profile, session, contact, or conversation data. NOTE: expected.results.itemIds lists lot ids only for readability - the real contract's BuyerSearchOutcome.items is a full AuctionLot[] (see packages/shared/src/auction-lot.ts).
